title: Princess and Conquest - Queen Of Clubs
description:
Princess & Conquest: Queen of Clubs is a tavern manager/simulator, with multiple minigames, and many Visual Novel elements! 

Animated 2D portraits and illustrated backgrounds, mixed to create a colorful world filled with cute and sexy characters, as always in the Princess & Conquest's Kingdom!

Together with Faun Princess, grow your establishment until it's recognized by Princesses all around the vast Kingdom!

Choose to play in Story or Roguelike Mode, the first being filled with cute, sexy events with Princesses coming to visit your newly opened Tavern, while the latter focuses on rounds after rounds of ROUGH gameplay, useful for testing your limits and possible builds to use in Story Mode!

You can romance the Princesses that come to your establishment! Quests and events usually culminate with beautiful animated scenes, starring the many (MANY) girls in our arsenal. They're all taken from the Princess & Conquest world, but there will be many new characters joining!

Tens, soon to be more than a hundred, of different items are going to change how you play the game, ranging from basic power-ups to powerful relics that summon helpers in your Tavern, assisting you in carrying drinks to picky Princesses and many other characters!
description_short: Princess & Conquest: Queen of Clubs is a tavern manager/simulator, with multiple minigames, and many narrative elements! Animated 2D portraits and illustrated backgrounds, mixed to create a colorful world filled with cute and sexy characters, as always in the Princess & Conquest's Kingdom!
